chunks: Your duty is only to warn him who fears it.

key_terms.يَخْشَاهَا: He fears it (referring to the Day of Judgment or God)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific duty of the Prophet regarding those who fear God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet’s role as a divine messenger rather than a compeller of faith, highlighting that effective warning requires the recipient's inherent readiness or 'khushya' (awe/fear of God). It reflects the principle that guidance is a divine gift, while the Prophet’s duty is merely to convey the message clearly to those whose hearts are open to it. This distinction reinforces the balance between human effort in propagation and divine will in acceptance.
